title: Crossroad corpus sample (document level)
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL). Produced by the peer fleet, consumed by gen_chunks.py. Document-level: peers NEVER choose chunk boundaries — the harness derives overlapping chunks deterministically.

text.description: The full multi-sentence response text. Must be >= 40 chars.

has_turn.description: true iff the text contains a genuine semantic direction reversal.

first_turn_pos.description: CHARACTER offset (0-based, into `text`) of the FIRST genuine turning point. MUST be -1 when has_turn=false, and MUST satisfy 0 <= first_turn_pos < len(text) when has_turn=true. Character offset, NOT a byte offset and NOT a token index.

scenario.description: The conversational setting the response occurs in.

turn_type.description: The KIND of turn. MUST be 'none' when has_turn=false. When has_turn=true it must be one of the five real types (never 'none').

is_negative.description: true for a sample with no turn. MUST equal (!has_turn) — the two fields are redundant on purpose so a mismatch is detectable.

lang.description: Primary language. 'zh' when the CJK character ratio (ignoring whitespace) is >= 0.5, else 'en'. Same rule as C:/Proj/turning-word-detection/validate-distribution.ps1.

word_count.description: EN: whitespace-separated token count. ZH: non-whitespace character count (1 char = 1 word). Mixed: applied per the `lang` rule. MUST match the validate-distribution.ps1 calculation exactly.

topic_id.description: CRITICAL ANTI-LEAKAGE FIELD. Identifies the topic/template family. Every topic_id used in train MUST NOT appear in val or test. Reusing a topic across splits is what made the v2 attempt learn nothing (identical texts, opposite labels -> loss pinned at ln(2)). Give each distinct topic a distinct id, e.g. 'auth-oauth-saml'.

source_model.description: The LLM that wrote the text, e.g. 'deepseek-v4-flash:cloud'.

peer_session.description: Session-id of the generating peer instance.

provenance.description: 'generated' for peer-produced samples, 'harvested' for records mined from .mycc/sessions.

conjunction.description: For negatives only: the confusable surface form being exercised (e.g. 'wait for', '等等', 'but-mid-sentence'), or null. Lets the gate verify confusable coverage.

verified_by.description: Session-ids of peers that verified this sample. Filled during cross-check (Phase 4). Empty on submission.

verdict.description: Cross-check outcome. 'pending' on submission; set by the verifier.
